verdict.rationale: Finix's official MCP server lets users ask an AI agent, such as Claude Code, natural-language questions about the Finix API and get documentation-based answers. The evidence describes only documentation Q&A, not natural-language commands that carry out operations such as payouts, onboarding or disputes. missing for 10: natural-language execution of product actions (payments, payouts, disputes, onboarding) through an agent or MCP tools, an in-dashboard natural-language interface, and independent hands-on corroboration.
